scope: Isolated Edge; synthetic page images and vision API only. No user profile or credentials accessed.

results.name: Caption identities reject in-text references and accept supplementary and Chinese labels
Untrusted AI JSON, invalid coordinates and mismatched labels are rejected without execution
Local extraction does not invoke AI and excludes anonymous graphics
Page range validation prevents requests before any page is transmitted
AI receives only explicitly selected pages; crops wait for visible preview confirmation
Duplicate AI reruns preserve existing crops and analyses, adding only confirmed missing candidates
Unnamed or misnumbered AI boxes cannot duplicate previously captured figures and tables
AI controls and crop preview fit a narrow viewport without horizontal overflow
Changed named crop requires explicit replacement selection
Malformed AI response, out-of-bounds box and HTTP 401 stop without adding or replacing crops
Stopping a stalled AI call cancels its API request and releases extraction controls
Changing the AI configuration dismisses an unconfirmed preview and keeps existing crops
Document replacement cancels pending AI and prevents stale crops from entering the new document
Document replacement dismisses unconfirmed previews without retaining private page crops
No uncaught errors or unexpected network requests
